verdict.rationale: Cerebras has a dedicated rate-limits docs page covering uncached TPM limits and how cached tokens don't count against them. The pricing page says the paid self-serve tier gets 10x higher rate limits than the free tier, which shows limits scale across tiers. However, the pack shows no concrete per-tier RPM/TPM figures or a full tier table, so a developer can't confirm actual numbers before hitting them; a community report of hitting the RPM limit instantly suggests the limits matter in practice. missing for 10: concrete numeric RPM/TPM values per tier, a documented tier-by-tier scaling table beyond the relative '10x' claim, and independent corroboration that the docs are sufficient for production planning.
